question: What is the value of 15 × 4 - (20 ÷ 5) + 3?
solution:
BODMAS Table

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/973bfabd173f36fc71fd9deb365eb125f9017295bb4c4859a4a5551f853a27f1.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given equation: 15 × 4 - (20 ÷ 5) + 3

Now, follow BODMAS:

⇒ 15 × 4 - (20 ÷ 5) + 3

⇒ 15 × 4 - 4 + 3

⇒ 60 - 4 + 3

⇒ 56 + 3 = 59

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
